scope: Bounded independent source-only audit of the requested native/order/objective/shuffle/reference risks.

findings.finding: Native make, seeds, scope, training_outputs, logits and metrics are AST-identical to the pinned parent. Ordinary/factorized constructor starts, Rademacher factor rows, AdamW ownership and persistent member dropout streams remain. Live H is the original output-head input from the same factual forward. Preparation uses one dedicated NumPy default_rng and no native/global RNG draw; the auxiliary has no random draw or extra forward.

Each fit keeps first strict full-VALID probability-mean accuracy improvement, earliest exact ties, unchanged stale-update patience and selected model/optimizer/stream restoration. New checkpoint metadata also checks context mode, target archive hash and TRAIN H order. NLL is not a selector tie breaker; selected native serving adds no context auxiliary.

Shared TRAIN H follows the supplied train_ids order. Every single and I4 body uses the original boolean-mask ascending node-ID order. A single argsort maps factual and shuffled weights/support and the full mask on both row and column axes. Relations are prepared once in factual TRAIN order and reused, rather than recomputed for references.

PRIVATE assigns one factual Q_r/E_r pair to each route. MIX computes each of four complete masked outside-log weighted target losses for each route, then averages contexts/routes; it does not combine Qbar with a union denominator. Literal float32 target row mass multiplies each log normalizer. FULL keeps factual Q and changes only the denominator to all nonself TRAIN rows. SHUFFLED uses both shuffled Q and its corresponding retained support.

Four fixed signatures use only public X/edges and ordered TRAIN IDs/labels. Incoming signature propagation deduplicates edges and inserts one self-loop without modifying the native predictor graph. Positives are nonself same-class stable top 16 or all eligible; every class needs at least two TRAIN nodes. A fixed class/positive-degree-bucket permutation jointly relabels both incidence axes, preserving per-anchor positive count, uniform weight/entropy and denominator count; matching E is reconstructed. Every context must change nontrivially on the one fixed draw, without retry or utility selection.

Ordinary M1, factorized M1 and each complete genuine factorized I4 body all use the full four-Q/E mixture. Each I4 fit constructs its own model, optimizer and streams, uses unscaled own CE plus 0.05 times its complete mixture auxiliary, and selects its own checkpoint. Its four selected outputs are pooled only after all four independent fits return. The four shared contrasts preserve the same native roster and mean-member objective scaling.

The fixed seven-arm/three-seed source closes 21 fresh banks and 30 independent optimizer fits. Its completion explicitly remains fresh acquisition only, requiring separately admitted 15 original banks / 33 selected-fit anchors for a joined 36 banks / 63 fits comparison. The direct CLI refuses scientific launch; root retains actual qualification and frozen complete-study admission.

root_remaining: Actual full-TRAIN target/support/shuffle nontriviality, live-gradient/order/RNG/checkpoint qualification, exact role/dependency/config admission and frozen complete joined predictive criteria remain root work. No optional mirror/math audit is requested.
